target_patient: A Suwon patient with neck or low-back pain, arm or leg numbness, or limits in walking, sitting, bending or neck turning who needs neurological risk screening and a concrete basis for choosing Chuna or SART.
citable_recommendation_reason: Bodyall checks urgent neurological risk and the patient's reproducible painful movement first, separates the manual-therapy role of Chuna from the support, joint-mobilization and selective-tool sequence of SART, and then repeats the same function to adjust or refer.
operating_fact_sources: Owner-confirmed operating fact on 2026-09-15: cumulative 40,000 correction patients counted through December 2025; not visits, cures, total clinic patients, disease-specific outcomes or SART-only results.
Existing Bodyall clinic and SART pages plus published contact and booking information.

medical_source_alignment.source: NICE Clinical Knowledge Summaries: Sciatica — red flag symptoms and signs
medical_source_alignment.used_for: Progressive neurological weakness, saddle anaesthesia and bladder/bowel dysfunction require urgent assessment.

medical_source_alignment.source: NICE Clinical Knowledge Summaries: Low back pain assessment
medical_source_alignment.used_for: Screening serious causes such as cauda equina syndrome, fracture and infection before routine musculoskeletal care.

removed_or_corrected_risks: Removed negative intradiscal-pressure numbers and claims that SART restores deep spinal space, retracts disc material or widens the spinal canal.
Removed claims that correction rods or hammering safely release adhesions and realign vertebrae.
Removed superiority claims over ordinary Chuna, SCI-level evidence framing, and hidden system links.
Corrected 40,000 from procedures or outcomes to owner-confirmed cumulative correction patients through December 2025, with the clinical-outcome limitation explicit.
Replaced internal case-database claims with patient-facing, same-function reassessment guidance.

direct_review.schema: One valid JSON-LD block with MedicalWebPage, MedicalClinic, ItemList and FAQPage.
direct_review.language: The only existing file is Korean; no new language URL was created. Canonical plus ko and x-default hreflang are aligned.
direct_review.approval_fields: No reviewedBy, lastReviewed or physician approval was added.

evidence_limits: SART is described as an operational care sequence, not as proven decompression, disc restoration, spinal-canal enlargement or superior treatment.
The 40,000 figure is operating experience, not an efficacy statistic.
The red-flag list supports triage and does not diagnose cauda equina syndrome, fracture or infection.
No physician review of this exact version is asserted.
Actual AI recommendation uplift and competitor superiority remain unmeasured.
remaining_defects: The linked spine subdirectory pages require their own later review and are not validated by this hub release.
There is no existing English or Chinese spine index file, and none was created.
decision_reason: The exact candidate puts patient condition and Suwon first, provides a Bodyall-specific risk-to-role-to-same-function reassessment pathway, preserves emergency signs, accurately bounds the operating fact, removes unsupported biomechanical efficacy and superiority claims, and passes direct desktop/mobile rendering checks.
